maddeler.e:
أتناحر (form VI)
# أَتَنَاحَرُ (ʔatanāḥaru) /ʔa.ta.naː.ħa.ru/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَنَاحَرَ (tanāḥara)
# أَتَنَاحَرَ (ʔatanāḥara) /ʔa.ta.naː.ħa.ra/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَنَاحَرَ (tanāḥara)
# أَتَنَاحَرْ (ʔatanāḥar) /ʔa.ta.naː.ħar/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَنَاحَرَ (tanāḥara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
